caption: The drawing depicts a lidded saucepan with a long handle, positioned horizontally across the page. The saucepan is cylindrical with a smooth, reflective outer surface indicated by shading and curved lines. The lid is circular with two stacked knobs and a small rounded tip at the top, centered in the drawing. The handle extends from the right side of the pot and is rendered with a tapered, slightly bulbous end, featuring dark shading to suggest it is made of a different material, possibly wood or dark metal. The drawing is done in graphite on a beige or off-white paper, creating a monochromatic look with various shades of gray used for shadows and reflections. There are no additional objects, patterns, or scenery; the background is plain.
title: Silver Serving Dish
